c: National Indigenous Crops Knowledge Tool: dataset behind the final tool
Every number and text the final tool uses, exported from the tool itself, with its source ID and status.

Published = traced to a source. Published (to verify) = needs a check at the original table. Derived = calculated here with a formula. Model = output of the project suitability model (uploaded by the data team). Content = text written by the project.

Nothing is estimated. District values missing for 15 districts are left out, as in the tool. Pilot yields, laboratory nutrients, field reports, seed sources and knowledge holders are not in the dataset because they have not been collected.
Column Source holds an ID (R01…R72) matching the Sources sheet (title, publisher, link, grade).
Blue = typed input. Black = formula. Formulas calculate ranks, bands, changes, scores, costs and priority flags.

Hitamo ahantu hari izuba n’ubutaka bworoshye.
Sow the tiny seed in rows, mixed with fine sand. Seed rate 1.5–2 kg per ha (R51b).
Tera imbuto zivanze n’umusenyi mu mirongo.
25 cm in the row and 50 cm between rows for a seed crop (R51b). Thin early and eat the thinnings.
Intera cm 25 mu murongo na cm 50 hagati y’imirongo.
Keep soil moist, not soggy; water in the morning.
Hira kugira ngo ubutaka butagwa umwuma.
Dig in 20–30 tonnes of manure per ha (2–3 kg per m²) before sowing (R51b).
Shyiramo ifumbire y’imborera mbere yo gutera.
Weed early, mulch with dry leaves, check weekly and hand-pick pests.
Kura ibyatsi hakiri kare utwikire n’ibyatsi byumye.
Ready in 30–40 days; repeat cuts, 6–10 in a season (project deck).
Steam or blanch 3–5 minutes. Long boiling can remove up to 99% of vitamin C (R44).
Let a few strong plants flower; dry the seed heads and rub out the seed.
Reka ibimera bike bisohore indabo ubone imbuto.
Sunny spot, 500–2,000 m, 18–30 °C, rich soil (R64, R66).
Raise seedlings in a nursery with 2–5 kg compost per m² and seed about 1 cm apart; transplant after about 4–5 weeks (R66).
10 plants per m² for leaf (R48); 20×20 cm for short crops, 50×50 cm for long production (R66).
Keep moist, especially in the first two weeks after transplanting.
Cattle manure 2–6 kg per m² plus about 60 kg N per ha for leaf production (R51b, R65).
First weeding two weeks after transplanting; mulch; watch for birds and caterpillars.
First pick from week 5; cut about 15 cm above the ground and pick weekly (R66).
Cook thoroughly and never eat raw. Steam rather than boil for long.
Collect ripe berries, wash out the seed, dry in shade, store sealed.
Warm sunny spot, optimum 18–25 °C, altitude up to 2,400 m, pH 5.5–7 (R67).
Mix seed 1:10 with sand and sow in rows or a seedbed; use three-week-old seedlings (R68, R49).
Wider spacing gives more leaves per plant; leaf yield reached 29 t per ha with good spacing and cutting (R49).
Favours steady water; tolerates some dry spells (R68).
About 3 kg of well-rotted manure per m² (R51b).
Weed early; look for aphids and vegetable bugs; rotate beds.
Cut tips often so the plant branches; yield rises with repeated cutting (R49, R50).
Blanch briefly; steaming keeps more vitamin C and folate (R45, R46).
Tie a cloth over ripe pods before they burst; dry the seed.
Warm, light shade; below 1,600 m; pH 5–6; well-drained soil (R69).
Raise seedlings in a nursery and plant out as a perennial shrub.
Allow space for a spreading shrub up to 3 m; plan for 3–4 years of production (R69).
Protect your hands from thorns; weed around the base.
First fruit after about 150–365 days; pick unripe fruit (R69, project deck).
Let some berries ripen fully, wash out the seed and dry it.

Inyabutongo carries 8.9 mg of iron per 100 g (project deck), about 19 times the 0.47 mg in cabbage.
Inyabutongo ifite fer 8.9 mg kuri 100 g, inshuro hafi 19 kurusha amashu.
Boiling or steaming leafy vegetables for 10 minutes removed up to 99% of vitamin C (Kinyi et al., 2022). Cook briefly.
Gutekesha iminota 10 bishobora gukuramo 99% bya vitamini C. Teka igihe gito.
Stunting fell from 51% in 2005 to 26.8% in 2025 (RDHS). Nearly one child in four is still affected.
Igwingira ryavuye kuri 51% muri 2005 rigera kuri 26.8% muri 2025.
In 2025, districts above 30% stunting fell from 20 to 11, yet Gicumbi is still at 38.8%.
Muri 2025 uturere turenze 30% twavuye kuri 20 tugera kuri 11.
Nightshade trials reached about 27 tonnes of leaf per hectare with a density of 10 plants per m².
Isogo mu bushakashatsi yageze kuri toni zigera kuri 27 kuri hegitari.
NST2 aims to cut stunting from 33% to 15% by 2029: about 3 points a year, three times the recent pace.
NST2 igamije kugabanya igwingira kuva kuri 33% kugeza kuri 15% muri 2029.
NCDs caused 49.5% of deaths in health facilities in 2025, up from 27.9% in 2019.
Indwara zitandura zateye 49.5% by’impfu zo kwa muganga muri 2025.
